description:
The Open Source Cowork Desktop to Unlock Your Exceptional Productivity.

Eigent is the open source cowork desktop application, empowering you to build, manage, and deploy a custom AI workforce that can turn your most complex workflows into automated tasks.
Built on CAMEL-AI's acclaimed open-source project, our system introduces a Multi-Agent Workforce that boosts productivity through parallel execution, customization, and privacy protection.
Eigent v1.0.3
Eigent v1.0.3 makes long-running work more reliable and turns each Space into a durable, versioned workspace.
Tasks can recover from interruptions, generated files are easier to inspect and review, and reusable workspace configurations help teams start complex work with less setup.
Highlights
- Durable Tasks and recovery
  - Resume interrupted Tasks after refreshing or restarting the app.
  - Preserve completed work without automatically repeating external actions.
  - Keep Task history, elapsed time, approvals, and recovery state available across sessions.
- Git-backed Spaces
  - Automatically initialize version history for Eigent-managed Spaces.
  - Reuse an existing Git repository when a selected folder already contains one.
  - Review Task-scoped file changes, diffs, checkpoints, branches, and version history.
- In-session Browser, Files, and Terminal
  - Open web pages, generated files, and an interactive local terminal without leaving the Session.
  - Preserve preview tabs and terminal state while switching between Sessions.
  - Inspect live and historical terminal output produced by agents.
- Improved file previews
  - Preview local HTML, images, PDFs, text files, and larger generated artifacts.
  - Open files normally or use View changes for a Task-scoped diff review.
- Workspace Bundles
  - Create reusable configurations containing agents, skills, MCPs, model profiles, context sources, permissions, environment requirements, and secret slots.
  - Validate and configure Bundles before running them.
- Scoped Memory
  - Save reusable notes at User, Space, and Session levels.
  - Search, organize, confirm, and archive Memory while keeping canonical Task history separate.
- New model provider
  - Added Ant Ling as a built-in OpenAI-compatible provider.
Reliability and UX improvements
- Improved approval, cancellation, timeout, and interrupted-Task handling.
- Added safer recovery when a tool may have produced an external side effect.
- Improved generated-file discovery and Task-scoped change boundaries.
- Hardened terminal lifecycle management and filtered credential-like environment values.
- Fixed the folded Task view scrolling unexpectedly.
- Improved compatibility with existing Sessions and historical Task data.
Compatibility
Existing Spaces, Sessions, and Task history remain available after upgrading. No additional configuration is required for the default v1.0.3 experience.
Full changelog: https://github.com/eigent-ai/eigent/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3
